maria_g: Heads-up — seeing a sharp p95/p99 bump on paged-attn after today's runtime push (deployed at 2390012300). Short sequences (<=64) p95 jumped ~12ms -> ~34ms. Posting trace snippets below.

maria_g: ```
2026-03-18T10:12:30Z | model=paged-attn | kernel=flash_paged_v2 -> latency: p50 8ms p95 34ms p99 78ms
selector: kernel_selector chose fused_flash for seq<=128, but runtime fell back to paged_fallback when kv_miss=true
```

maria_g: Anyone else seeing this? @kevin_h @oliver_b

kevin_h: saw the same on canary earlier. I pushed a perf harness and it's reproducible. Correlates with a spike in cold-KV evictions around the same window.

ci-bot: deploy redwood-runtime/3.14.0 by deployer@ci at 2390012300

oliver_b: grabbed kernel-selection logs from a canary request:
```
[10:12:29] selector: seq=64 predicted_path=flash_paged_v1 score=0.82 -> chosen=fused_flash
[10:12:29] runtime: cache_miss=true -> route=fallthrough_paged (slower path)
```
oliver_b: looks like the selector scoring shifted and we're hitting the slower fallthrough for short seqs when kv_miss=true.

sana_p: quick microbench on an rtx pool: 
```
cmd: ./bench_attn --model paged --seq 64 --kernel fused_flash --iters 200
results before (commit abc123): p95=11.2ms p99=25.1ms
results after  (commit def456): p95=33.8ms p99=76.3ms
```

jess_r: yikes. that's a big delta. any KV policy changes in def456?

maria_g: def456 included two changes: `kv_adjacent_eviction` tweak and a selector weight tweak for kernel scoring. suspect interaction between them.

kevin_h: I ran a bisect locally across abc123..def456. Culprit looks like commit cde789 which loosened selector weight toward fused paths. Bisect snippet: 
```
commit cde789: selector.score_weight_kv changed from -0.5 -> -0.15
effect: less penalty for predicted kv_miss -> fused_flash chosen more often
```
kevin_h: reverting that weight locally restores p95 to ~12ms.

infra-oncall: can we rollback canary to abc123 while we triage? if safe, do a controlled rollback; we should avoid a global rollback yet.

maria_g: +1. I'll open a rollback PR and pin the selector heuristic for canary.

maria_g: PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/432 (revert selector weight; pin fused_flash threshold for seq<=128)

ci-bot: PR opened by maria_g: #432

oliver_b: i'll add a unit/regression test that simulates high cold-kv rate and asserts selector prefers paged path for short seqs.

sana_p: i'll run the full kernel matrix (flash_fused vs flash_paged vs paged_fallback) across seqs [16,32,64,128,256] overnight and upload CSV to the perf dashboard.

jess_r: next steps: rollback canary to abc123, add selector/regtests, and schedule a measured rollout to dedicated next week. @eng-sre please create an alert: paged-attn p99 > 50ms for more than 5m.

kevin_h: note for root cause write-up: selector scoring now over-preferences fused_flash for short sequences when kv_miss rate spikes. We should couple kernel selection to an expected_kv_hit_rate signal (or add a hard threshold that forces paged path on cold-kv).

maria_g: agreed. Proposed immediate mitigation: select fused_flash only when (expected_kv_miss_rate < 0.2) OR (seq > 128). I'll draft a short RFC and include fallback telemetry hooks.

maria_g: thanks all — will follow up with the PR + perf artifacts. :thumbsup:
